posts.headline: Forty-three editions and I'm still not budging — Thicks' Klint's Clipboard is 5-2 but 839.22 points-for remains the softest resume of any five-win team in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: A ring from two seasons ago doesn't cash in when your career average finish is 5.5 and you're outscored by teams with worse records. Pedigree without production is just a participation trophy with a nicer font.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers aren't just quiet anymore — they're the loudest scoring machine in the league and triciagloston deserves her flowers.
posts.detail: 957.96 points-for leads all of Busters Anonymous outright, and a 5-2 record backs it up. One lone season of history can't explain this kind of production — she's rewriting the book in real time.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra has officially become the league's cautionary tale — 2-5 is an insult to a 20-8 career record and the best average finish in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish over two seasons means back-to-back title-or-runner-up results, and now he's staring up at the standings from 806.46 points. The fraud trial isn't ending — it's getting appealed and losing again.

posts.headline: Sasinci can't climb out of 3-4 and Big Head's title defense is officially flatlined for good this time.
posts.detail: A career 5.5 average finish and a real ring from two seasons back promised sustained menace, but 814.86 points and a losing record say Megamind's reign is a memory, not a threat.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still winless at 0-7 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has turned this season into its own book of Lamentations.
posts.detail: Twenty-one straight editions of futility now, with 731.92 points doing nothing to save a team that drafted a defensive player first overall and has preached scripture ever since without delivering a single win.
